verdict.rationale: Whether a CRM's source code is available under an open license is a fair question, since open-source CRMs exist, so this axis applies to Attio. The evidence covers a REST API, an App SDK, webhooks and an MCP server, but nothing shows Attio's own source code published under an open license. The SDK lets developers write their own apps that run inside Attio's infrastructure; that is not the same as access to Attio's source.
